title: Cosmic experience is implicit, not explicit

statements.text: In the field’s unorganized ground state the phenomenal nuances lie dormant and undifferentiated, in potentia rather than actual. So cosmic consciousness need not experience any of them as actual states, and no ordinary experience can be read into the field’s default state. This answers the austerity worry: the field is rich in potential without being rich in the explicit way human experience is.
